title: SeaCraft
description: Explore vast oceans, build ships with physics, and master Create automation in a soulslike world.
body:
# 🌊 Seacraft

A modpack focused on **naval exploration, challenging combat, and Create-based engineering**, blending adventure, magic, and technology into a vast and dangerous world.

Inspired by ocean exploration, soulslike combat, and technical progression, Seacraft delivers a complete journey — from basic survival to mastering the seas.

---

## ⚔️ Features

* 🌊 **Naval & Ocean Exploration**

  * Physics-based ships with Valkyrien Skies + Eureka
  * Living oceans filled with creatures and unique structures

* ⚙️ **Engineering & Automation (Create)**

  * Complex machinery, logistics, and energy systems
  * Expansions like Create: New Age, Additions, and Big Cannons

* ⚔️ **Soulslike Combat**

  * Better Combat + Combat Roll
  * Soulslike Weaponry + Spell Engine
  * Stronger enemies and more tactical fights

* 🗺️ **Massive World Generation**

  * Tectonic + Terralith + Continents
  * Dungeons, structures, and settlements everywhere

* 🧙 **Magic & RPG Progression**

  * Spell Engine + Runes + class systems
  * Diverse weapons, builds, and playstyles

* 🏰 **Adventure & Exploration**

  * Dungeons Arise, Awesome Dungeons, Aquamirae
  * Villages, towers, oceans, and hidden ruins

---

## 🎯 Modpack Goal

Seacraft is designed to deliver a unique experience combining:

* 🌊 deep ocean exploration
* ⚔️ challenging and tactical combat
* ⚙️ advanced Create engineering
* 🗺️ a vast world full of discoveries

---

## ⚠️ Notes

* Modpack is still in development
* Balance and content may change
* Some systems may be challenging for new players

---

## 🌊 Set Sail

Build your ship, forge your build, and explore a world where **the ocean is as dangerous as it is beautiful**.
